evidence: Added "Notes" text field via Configure Fields dialog; it immediately appeared as a new column header in the table view with "—" placeholder for existing rows.
Added entry "Test Entry Alpha" via Add Entry dialog; it appeared immediately in table as 6th row with all field values, entry count updated to "6 entries".
Entered text "Test Entry Alpha", number 5, date 2026-09-01, checkbox=true, notes text; all saved correctly and displayed as "Test Entry Alpha | 5 | Sep 1, 2026 | check-icon | sample note" in table.

Configure Fields dialog shows labeled type dropdowns (Text/Number/Date/Checkbox) per field; Add Entry form renders type-appropriate controls: textbox for text, spinbutton for number, native input[type=date] for date, checkbox toggle (No/Yes) for checkbox.
Form checkbox toggles between "Completed No" and "Completed Yes" [checked] state. Table view renders green check icon (text-success) for true vs gray X icon (text-muted-foreground) for false.
Switched from Table to Cards view via Cards button; all 6 entries and their field values (including newly added "Test Entry Alpha") displayed unchanged as cards.
All 6 entries and every field (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) shown consistently in both table and card views; empty Notes value rendered as "—" placeholder in both views.

Card view: sorted by Priority ascending then toggled to descending (5,3,2,2,1,1 order). Switched to Table view: sort reset to inactive (no field selected), then set Due Date ascending independently (Jan14→Sep1). Confirms independent per-view sort state and asc/desc support for any field.

Selecting "Priority" in Sort menu immediately reordered cards; Sort button label changed to "Priority" and footer showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)"/"(descending)" after toggling. App remained fully interactive after sorting (view switch, further clicks worked).

After sorting by Priority (asc/desc) and Due Date (asc), entry count remained "6 entries" throughout and each entry's field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) were unchanged, only order changed.

With no field sort active, dragged "Design new landing page" via keyboard (Space/Arrow/Space) to a new position in Table view (result: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Test Entry Alpha) and separately in Card view (result: Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design, Test Entry Alpha). Switching between views preserved each view's distinct manual order; entry count (6) and values unaffected.
Typing "test" (lowercase) matched "Test Entry Alpha" (capitalized) — case-insensitive text match; footer showed "1 entry matching \"test\"". Clearing the search restored all 6 entries in prior order.

issue: Quick search does not match displayed/formatted field values for date and checkbox fields
actual: Searching "Jan 15" (the exact due-date text shown for "Design new landing page") returned "0 entries matching \"Jan 15\"" instead of matching that entry. Searching "Yes" (the exact Completed value shown for several entries) also returned 0 results. Search appears to only match raw/internal values (e.g. ISO date strings or text/number fields), not the human-readable values rendered in the UI.

issue: No filter feature is present in the application
actual: Searched the entire UI (toolbar, column headers via click and right-click, Configure Fields dialog, Add Entry dialog) and the full DOM for any "filter" affordance. Toolbar only exposes Search, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, and Add Entry — no way to define field-specific filter criteria or view only matching entries.

issue: No filter feature exists to verify inclusion/exclusion criteria or restoration behavior
actual: No filter UI could be located anywhere in the app (toolbar, headers, dialogs, or DOM scan for "filter"-related attributes), so field-specific filter criteria cannot be applied or cleared.

evidence: In Add Entry form, typing "abc" into the Priority number field left it unchanged at "0" (non-numeric characters rejected by the numeric input). Typing "42" was accepted and, after submission, the entry displayed "42" correctly in the Priority column.

Attempting to set the Due Date field to an invalid calendar date "2026-13-45" (month 13, day 45) resulted in the date input being cleared/rejected (value reverted to empty) rather than accepting the invalid date, confirming the date field enforces valid calendar dates only.

issue: No data import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the Configure Fields dialog (which references importing data in a note), the main toolbar, and the full DOM (no input[type=file], no button/link/menuitem containing "import") — there is no UI control to import data at all, so field-schema-gated import validation cannot be exercised.
